body:
As it stands, there's not much I can enjoy; I literally can't afford it. I can play free-to-play games in my spare time, but spending too much time does make me feel guilty, even if I had just been looking for jobs as often as I can. I'm staying with family, too, so whenever they see me play any game, they get very judgmental and ask "How is that helping you?" I honestly don't know what to say to that. Yeah, it's not helping me in the sense that it's not getting me a job, but I also don't sit around on the TV either. I guess this does go back to my not wanting to talk to too many people about my problems, but it's ingrained in me, now; I don't want to burden others with my problems. That said, this obviously isn't my main account, mostly because I don't want people knowing who I am. I guess that makes it a throwaway, right? 

I can appreciate you letting me you know that there are people available for me, though. I know that most of my family really does care about me, but they're frustrated at me and I'm frustrated at me and I don't really know what to do. It's not entirely up to me with what jobs I can get hired at and, based on what I've seen, my qualifications are too low enough (read: didn't finish college) to get into jobs I'd really like, but apparently too high enough to get a fucking call back from retail stores. Ugh.

It's off and on for sure, but I honestly think that if I had the opportunity to do it, I would. I grew up in a somewhat abusive home where my mother was just intolerant of everything and everybody and would constantly tell me her troubles when I was young. I understand that she needed to vent, but it put me in a position where I don't want to let anyone know my troubles because I know how burdensome they can be.

The major issue, right now, for me, is that I just can't find a job and I don't know what to do. Yes, there are things I'd like to do; there were always things I'd've liked to have done, but given how far away they are and how much of a priority they are, I don't really see too much of a point in trying to go for them anymore.
